ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 5-8% high-intensity (white) localized focal points and edge highlights.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Clusters of high-intensity pixels localized at the distal tips of both lobes; a singular vertical linear high-intensity feature located on the left lobe approximately 20% from the lateral edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; internal angle estimated at 40 degrees; notch depth occupies approximately 12% of the visible vertical fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration pattern; peaks vary in pixel amplitude between 3 and 12 pixels; frequency of peaks increases towards the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curvature from the median notch extending towards the distal tips; terminal points exhibit a sharp posterior-lateral orientation.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast circular clusters on the left distal tip and scattered high-intensity points across the right lobe trailing edge region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent vertical high-intensity line on the left lobe; several shorter, less defined vertical streaks near the base of the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive high-intensity pigment loss (scars) on the distal tips and irregular notches along the trailing edge indicating past physical interaction.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive 'saw-tooth' profile on the medial-right trailing edge section with higher amplitude peaks compared to the left lobe.
